entities.summary: WaterWorld Themed Waterpark Ayia Napa is a water park destination in Ayia Napa, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A large Greek-mythology-themed water park whose theming and ride range make it a destination rather than a routine resort pool complex. This entry is intended for 5–adult travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
